u_pageTableSize.description: must match TerrainPageManager::PageTableSize; feedback page coords are 5+5 bits

u_frameTag.description: 8-bit submitted-epoch tag written into feedback alpha; 0 is reserved for invalid

u_pageResolution.description: must match TerrainPageManager::PageResolution; used for the same half-texel page inset as M_terrain

u_uvScale.description: M_terrain u_uvScale; the layer feedback must reproduce the same layer UV as the material

u_layerPageResolution.description: VT layer page resolution; must match TerrainLayerPageManager::PageResolution

u_layerMaxMip.description: maximum VT layer page-table mip, same value as M_terrain

u_layerFeedbackEnabled.description: 1 when the active World uses layer mode 1 and the 4 layer attachments carry L4b feedback; 0 keeps them invalid

u_feedbackScaleX.description: screen width / 128; converts this 128x128 pass's derivatives to main-view derivatives so the requested mip matches M_terrain
